availability_policy: Release dates verified from original issuer pages. Two decision-relevant filings have SEC acceptance verified.

formulas.revenue_yoy_pct: 100*(quarter revenue / same fiscal quarter prior-year revenue - 1)
formulas.revenue_yoy_acceleration_pp: current revenue YoY % minus prior sequential quarter revenue YoY %
formulas.operating_margin: 100*operating income / revenue; uses reported dollar values, not rounded presentation margin
formulas.guide_miss_beat: current actual versus previous release's management guidance for this same quarter, not analyst consensus
formulas.guide_sequence: next-quarter guide versus just-reported actual: changing target quarter, not a same-quarter revision

limits: Selected-winner sample cannot measure false positives or predictive breadth.
No dated historical analyst estimate vintage, earnings-surprise consensus, or revision series reconstructed.
No primary transcript Q&A collected; management evidence consists of release statements and filing MD&A.
Only latest preselection 10-Q for each issuer independently tied to SEC index acceptance; earlier evidence is issuer release based.
No reclassified recurring earnings series imposed. Adjustment differences are retained.
STX next-quarter gross/operating margin is not guided numerically in the reviewed releases.
Yfinance/current ratios cannot establish contemporaneous expectations or institutional accumulation.
inference: Both issuers show recovery from depressed comparison periods, supply/cost discipline and cloud-related product mix improvements. Different physical drivers and mixed pricing mean this is a plausible common economic-family hypothesis, not a single commodity cycle or established cause of share appreciation.
